title: K Swap Adapter Harness Honda
body_html:
Description
 

This adapter is made to allow the installation of a K-Series engine with the 02-04 K20 engine harness. It will also work for our all our K-Series engine harnesses.


This wire harness connects your K-Series engine harness to your chassis interior harness while adding the E-plug and all its functions. This harness is primarily made for a K-Pro or Re-Flashed Computer but can be used with a stock RSX Computer provided you have bypassed the immobilizers accordingly.

This harness may require the user to pull the shock tower plugs into the interior for a better fit and cleaner installation. You are also required to drill a small hole in your exhaust tunnel for the O2 Sensor plug.

After a year of R&D, this method is the way our customers doing this swap said were the best & cleanest. There will be 5 wires to be connected to your factory computer plugs with a diagram that accurately shows which wires to connect to. You won't use your stock engine harness with the K20, but you still continue to use your chassis Interior harness with this conversion, so don't toss it or cut it!

We also offer this jumper harness for the K powered Honda Insight. If you have a Insight, we will need your original Insight harness to borrow a couple connectors off of.

title: Rywire V2 Engine Harness Honda K20
body_html: Version 2 of the Rywire K-series engine harness was created to facilitate a more universal chassis, and harness routing preference. This style can be routed more like the OEM k-series engine harness through the center or more to the right on the firewall than it's Version 1 counterpart. This routing method is ideal for our (RHD) Right Hand Drive customers however NOT exclusive to RHD chassis and does work fine on a LHD chassis. Version 2 is also routed in a way that allows you to get around aggressive headers.

title: DRAG PRO+ SERIES COILOVERS - 92-00 CIVIC EG EK / 94-01 INTEGRA DC
body_html:
Available 3/9/24

 

The BLOX Racing Drag Pro+ system now offers more serious straight line performance that will significantly increase starting line traction and lower 60-ft times. Maximizing both will help lower overall quarter mile ET and increase MPH. The DP+ system further increases high speed stability.

The DP+ system features 32-way damping adjustment that increases stiffness at each corner and provides more precise suspension tuning. Each adjustment increases stiffness by +5 kg/mm. The DP+ system also includes new pillow ball upper mounts that eliminate deflection associated with rubber bushings. 

The dual-ride height and 32-way adjustability gives the driver the tools necessary to fine tune each corner to help minimize weight transfer and maximize starting line traction.

Each kit comes with 32-way adjustable struts, specifically weighted front and rear coil springs, adjustable perches, pillow ball upper mounts and billet aluminum lower adjustable mounts for EG/DC and EK or ITR control arms. Each kit also includes new dust covers, bump stops and spanner wrench set. 

DRAG PRO+ COILOVER FEATURES

  • Mono tube design
  • FR: 12kg/mm; RR: 18kg/mm
  • 32-way adjustable damping
  • Spherical bearing pillow ball upper mounts
  • Track-proven 18kg/mm rear springs
  • Dual ride adjustability for finer corner scaling
  • Lower 60' times
  • Quicker quarter mile ETs
  • Greater high speed stability and control

VEHICLE APPLICATIONS

  • 92-95 Civic
  • 92-97 Delsol
  • 96-00 Civic
  • 94-01 Integra (Non Type-R)

title: TurboSmart GenV RacePort BOV
body_html:
TurboSmart GenV RacePort BOV

The Turbosmart RacePort is famous for being an amazingly small and light BOV for turbocharged competition level engines. Featuring our unique collar design and internal flow structures, it is 50% lighter and 25% smaller than the competition while flowing 330 CFM – making it the highest flowing BOV of it’s type on the market.

Features:

 

  • GenV Raceport 50mm BOV
  • 1/8 NPT Vacuum fittings
  • V-band Assembly
  • Profiled Alloy Weld-On Fitting
  • Blue Spring Rated -18 to -14 InHg (installed).
  • Turbosmart Decal

title: Turbosmart GenV HyperGate 14psi External Wastegate (45mm or 60mm V-Band)
body_html:
The GenV External Wastegate from Turbosmart was a ground up rework of a classic and the only feature that rolled over from the Gen4 range was the mounting orientation. CFD optimized and validated in-house for maximum flow and thermal management, the GenV range has more features, options and performance than any other gate like it. 

A direct fit upgrade to all Gen4 Turbosmart wastegates and feature our unique collar-locking system, variable actuator cap and base for easy, 360 degree optional routing of reference hoses, strap-type V-band clamps, optional liquid-cooling provision, 1/8″ NPT reference ports and are provided with the full range of available springs.

title: TRANSLAB K SERIES VSS BLOCK OFF
body_html:
Translab billet K series VSS blockoff plugs.

Perfect for guys running the Rear VSS inner case with an outer case that has the VSS provision in it or those running NO transmission based VSS.

CnC machined out of high quality T6-6061 aluminum, the plug comes anodized black complete with stainless allen bolt and reusable O-ring.

title: TRANSLAB K-AWD BILLET TRANSFER CASE BLOCK OFF
body_html:
Translab billet transfer case block off plate fitting K series Element/CRV transmissions.

These will also fit THEFEWH22CREW's H22 billet bellhousing as they too use K transfer cases. https://thefewh22crew.com/

These are a clean way to block off transfer case openings on your AWD transmission. They fit OEM and all aftermarket billet cases. Perfect for guys going AWD and wanting to do it in steps, go back an forth between running AWD/FWD classes, or for those guys storing spare/backup transmission(s).

title: Translab B/H series bottom countershaft shim
body_html:
Bottom Countershaft washer/shim:
Washer A (40X54X1.95)
Translab custom ground washer/shim that replaces discontinued OEM Honda Part number: 23921-PK5-900

 These are custom ground to replace damaged or lost bottom countershaft shims that have been discontinued by Honda For most all B (FWD and AWD) and H/F transmissions

 

Fitting:

B series hydro and cable transmissions (Including small spline) EXCEPT JDM 4.7 Type R.

F/H 22-23 (All USDM, JDM and EDM), F20B

title: TRANSLAB BILLET B SERIES AWD BILLET CUFF
body_html:
Fitting All synchro OEM offerings and aftermarket gearsets utilizing OEM type final drive (GEAR-X USA, Graff, BF Gears, Saenz, OEM etc)

All cuffs come assembled complete with spacers bearing etc.

title: TRANSLAB B AWD-SBXM billet transfer case block off plate
body_html:
Translab billet transfer case block off plate fitting AWD B-SBXM transmissions.

These are a clean way to block off transfer case openings on your AWD SBXM transmission. They fit OEM (PBW1 and 2) and all aftermarket billet cases. Perfect for guys going AWD and wanting to do it in steps, go back an forth between running AWD/FWD classes, or for those guys storing spare/backup transmission(s).

CnC machined out of high quality T6-6061 aluminum, complete with 10.9 allen bolts and reusable gasket.

title: Translab billet input shaft thrust tool
body_html:

* Will need a base and dial indicator gauge
